UPDATE latest_jellyfin_session
            SET item_id = NULL,
                item_name = NULL,
                item_type = NULL,
                series_name = NULL,
                season = NULL,
                episode = NULL,
                position_seconds = NULL,
                play_method = NULL,
                paused = false,
                event_id = $2,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE session_id = $1
